import json
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
from geometry_msgs.msg import PoseStamped
from nav2_msgs.action import NavigateToPose
from oomwoo_coverage.coverage_planner_node import CoveragePlanner
from oomwoo_sim_support.coverage_regression_runner import CoverageRunner

def test_single_selected_goal_and_no_gapfill():
    points=CoveragePlanner._plan_waypoints(NS(global_frame='map'))
    assert len(points)==1 and points[0].header.frame_id=='map'
    assert (points[0].pose.position.x,points[0].pose.position.y)==(4.225,.025)
    assert CoveragePlanner._gapfill_waypoints(NS())==[]

def test_feedback_trace_is_bounded_and_retains_original_truth():
    node=NS(info=None,motion_audit=True,_audit_keepout_truth=lambda msg:None,
            motion_samples={'feedback':[]},_sim_now=lambda:2.)
    truth=PoseStamped();truth.header.frame_id='map';truth.header.stamp.sec=1
    truth.pose.orientation.w=1.
    feedback=NavigateToPose.Impl.FeedbackMessage();feedback.goal_id.uuid=[1]*16
    for i in range(200):
        truth.header.stamp.nanosec=i*1000;truth.pose.position.x=float(i)
        CoverageRunner._on_pose(node,truth)
        feedback.feedback.current_pose=truth
        feedback.feedback.distance_remaining=float(i)/10.
        CoverageRunner._audit_feedback(node,feedback)
    trace=node.motion_samples['focal_motion']
    assert len(trace)==192
    assert trace[0]['truth']['position'][0]==8.
    assert trace[0]['truth']['stamp_ns']==1000008000
    assert trace[-1]['feedback']['distance_remaining']==19.9
    truth.pose.position.x=999.
    assert trace[-1]['truth']['position'][0]==199.

def test_existing_status_reply_trace_is_bounded_without_blocking_updates():
    logs=[]
    packet={'owner':'navigation','motion_inputs':{'navigation':{'zero':False,'age':.02}},
            'last_output':[.14,0.],'motion_health':{},'nav_uuid_evidence':{}}
    reply=NS(ok=True,status_json=json.dumps(packet))
    future=NS(done=lambda:True,result=lambda:reply)
    node=NS(_relay_rpc=None,_relay_status_future=future,
            _relay_status_epoch=1,_relay_epoch=1,
            _relay_status_client=NS(service_is_ready=lambda:False),
            _relay_stage='nav',_relay_uuid='01'*16,robot_xy=(4.,-.2),robot_yaw=0.,
            get_clock=lambda:NS(now=lambda:NS(nanoseconds=2000000000)),
            get_logger=lambda:NS(info=lambda msg:logs.append(msg)))
    for i in range(200):
        node._relay_status_future=future
        CoveragePlanner._relay_poll(node)
    assert len(logs)==192 and node._focal_trace_count==192
    sample=json.loads(logs[-1].split(' ',1)[1])
    assert sample['nav_input']['zero'] is False and sample['output']==[.14,0.]
    assert node._relay_snapshot==packet and node._relay_status_future is None
